title: Exporting for Android
key_points: Projects can be exported to Android using Godot.
Fewer requirements are needed compared to compiling Godot for Android.
OpenJDK 17 must be installed and configured in the editor settings.
Android SDK, including required packages and NDK, must also be installed and configured.
Exporting projects to Android has specific launcher icon requirements.
limitations: Support for C# projects is experimental and some limitations apply
Projects written in C# can be exported but support is still in early stages
asserts: This page describes how to export a Godot project to Android, detailing the required steps including installing OpenJDK 17, configuring Android SDK, and setting it up in the Godot editor settings.
scope: The scope of this guide is the process of exporting a Godot game or project to an Android platform for mobile device distribution using the specific configurations and tools mentioned within the tutorial.
